items.raw_excerpt: Ein Fest für Familien, Gäste und Freunde wurde in Schleedorf gefeiert SCHLEEDORF. Eine Trachten-Modenschau, Kutschenfahrten und Spiele standen beim Dorf- und Familienfest in Schleedorf auf dem Programm, das von der Trachtenmusikkapelle eröffnet wurde.
items.summary_en: The village of Schleedorf in Austria held a family and village festival. People watched a traditional dress show, rode in horse carriages and played games. The local costume music band opened the celebration.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아의 슬레도르프 마을에서 가족과 이웃을 위한 축제가 열렸다. 전통 의상쇼를 구경하고 마차를 타고 여러 놀이를 즐겼다. 지역 전통악기 악대가 축제를 열었다.
items.title_en: Village Festival in Schleedorf: A Lovely Day for Families
items.title_ko: 슬레도르프 마을축제: 가족을 위한 즐거운 마을 축제
items.title_original: Dorffest in Schleedorf: Feines Dorf- und Familienfest - MeinBezirk.at

items.raw_excerpt: Students who have enrolled for a sociology course at the University of Amsterdam this year have been told to leave electronic devices at the door and go back to taking notes by hand. The UvA has banned laptops, mobile phones and tablets from lectures and classes in interdisciplinary social science, on the grounds that they interefere with students’ concentration. Senior lecturer Cyrilien Evertsen told NOS that “60% to 80% of students are doing things on digital devices during classes other...
items.summary_en: The University of Amsterdam is banning laptops, phones, and tablets from lectures to help students focus. The rule applies to interdisciplinary social science courses this year.
items.summary_ko: 암스테르담 대학은 학생들의 집중력을 높이기 위해 강의실에서 노트북과 휴대폰, 태블릿 사용을 금지합니다. 이 조치는 올해부터 사회과학 분야 강의에 적용됩니다.
items.title_en: Amsterdam university bans laptops in lecture halls

items.raw_excerpt: El cuadro albo visita a los sureños en el duelo de ida de cuartos de final. La revancha será el martes 6 de octubre.
items.summary_en: Colo Colo travels south to face Puerto Montt in the first leg of the Copa Chile quarterfinals. The second match will be played on Tuesday, October 6.

items.raw_excerpt: Most of our readers believe that no one single group is to blame for Spain's current housing crisis, but rather that they all contribute to a vicious circle. Here's what The Local Spain's readers have to say.
items.summary_en: Readers explain why they think Spain's housing crisis has no single cause. Many say buyers, sellers, banks, and governments all push prices up in a loop.
items.summary_ko: 독자들은 스페인 주택난의 원인은 한쪽 탓이 아니라고 답했다. 매수자 매도자 은행 정부 모두가 서로의 행동을 부추겨 값을 계속 끌어올리는 순환이 된다는 설명이다.
items.title_en: Readers blame everyone for Spain's housing crisis

items.title_original: 'Every interested party is to blame': Your views on Spain's housing crisis

items.raw_excerpt: Many people in Denmark choose to rent out their homes while they go away, particularly using the platform Airbnb. But if the rental is not approved by a landlord or housing association, it can lead to you having to give up your tenancy.
items.summary_en: Many people in Denmark rent out their homes while they travel, often on Airbnb. If a landlord or housing association does not approve it, the owner can lose their own tenancy. Rules differ between private owners and housing association tenants.
items.summary_ko: 덴마크에서는 여행을 떠날 때 Airbnb 같은 플랫폼으로 자기 집을 빌려주는 사람이 많습니다. 임대인이나 주택협 동의 승인을 받지 않으면 본인의 임대차 계약까지 잃을 수 있습니다. 개인 소유주와 주택협 임차인의 규정은 서로 다릅니다.
items.title_en: Rules for renting out your home in Denmark
items.title_original: What are the rules if you want to Airbnb your home in Denmark?

items.raw_excerpt: "Mit Charme" (charming) and "Gemütlich" (cosy) might sound appealing, but in Austria’s property market, those German words can mean something else entirely.
items.summary_en: Estate agents in Austria sometimes use German words such as "charming" and "cosy" to make a flat sound nice. These soft words can hide real problems with the building. Buyers should ask questions before they sign.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아에서는 부동산중개인이 '아늑하다', '매력적이다' 같은 독일어 단어로 집을 좋게 설명하는 경우가 있다. 하지만 이런 부드러운 표현이 실제 집의 문제를 감출 수도 있다. 계약 전에 반드시 따로 확인해야 한다.
items.title_en: German words Austrian agents use to fool buyers
items.title_ko: 오스트리아 부동산중개인이 쓰는 속삭이는 독일어 단어들
items.title_original: 'Cosy and charming': The German words Austrian estate agents might use to rip you off

items.raw_excerpt: ESA row intensifies pressure on UDF in Pathanamthitta over village exclusions and land demarcation amid protests and fears of conflict.
items.summary_en: In Pathanamthitta district, a dispute over land survey maps is putting pressure on the ruling party. Villagers say some villages were left out of the survey work, and protests are growing. Locals fear the row could grow into a bigger conflict.
items.summary_ko: 인도 케랄라주 파타남티타 지구에 경계와 토지 측정 문제가 커지면서 여당에 압박이 몰리고 있다. 주민들은 몇 개 마을이 측정 대상에서 빠졌다고 말하고 있으며 시위도 계속되고 있다. 지역에서는 다툼이 더 큰 충돌로 번질 수 있다고 걱정한다.
items.title_en: Land Survey Row Puts Kerala Party Under Pressure
items.title_ko: 토지 측정 다툼 속 케랄라 여당에 압박 커지나
items.title_original: ESA exclusion row puts UDF under pressure in Pathanamthitta

items.raw_excerpt: A December move will temporarily restrict access to Salzburg's citizenship department and change where applicants should send documents.
items.summary_en: The citizenship office in Salzburg will move in December. Access will be limited during the move, and applicants must send their documents to a new address.
items.summary_ko: 12월에 잘츠부르크 시민권 사무소가 임시로 이전합니다. 이전 기간 동안 이용이 제한되며, 신청자는 문서를 새 주소로 보내야 합니다.
items.title_en: Salzburg citizenship office to move temporarily
items.title_original: What you need to know about Salzburg's citizenship office move

items.raw_excerpt: Former MLA and Janata Dal (Secular) leader K.B. Prasanna Kumar on Tuesday demanded the resignation of School Education Minister Madhu Bangarappa over the recent corruption allegation made by Shivamogga Urban Development Authority (SUDA) chairman H.S. Sundaresh.
items.summary_en: A former state lawmaker wants Education Minister Madhu Bangarappa to resign. The demand came after a city development board chief said the minister was involved in corruption. The former lawmaker belongs to the Janata Dal Secular party.
items.summary_ko: 카르나타카주 출신 전 의원이 마두 반가라파 교육부장 사퇴를 요구했다. 시바모가 도시 개발 기관장 수소타레쉬가 반가라파를 대상으로 뇌물혐의를 제기한 뒤 나온 요구다. 요구자는 자나타달 세쿨러당 소속이다.
items.title_en: Former lawmaker demands education minister quit
items.title_original: Former MLA demands Madhu Bangarappa’s resignation

items.raw_excerpt: The Mamativa Association is launching Beyond Breast Cancer, an international patient education and support initiative created to support women living with or beyond breast cancer, with a particular focus on the international community living in the Algarve.
items.summary_en: The Mamativa Association is starting a new project called Beyond Breast Cancer. It will give support and information to women who have breast cancer and to women who finished treatment. The project also wants to help foreign women who live in the Algarve.
items.summary_ko: 마마티바 협회가 '비욘드 브레스 캔서'라는 이름의 새 지원을 시작한다. 유부암 치료 중인 여성과 치료를 마친 여성에게 정보와 지 원을 준다. 알가르브에 사는 외국인 여성도 함께 돕는 것이 목표다.
items.title_en: New Support Project for Women with Breast Cancer in the Algarve
items.title_ko: 알가르브 유부암 여성을 위한 새 지원 사업
